primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t the LORD anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?

All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 割当1サムエル記の該当箇所は「イスラエル」領域を地名として名指さない。10:1は「嗣業の君主」、11:15はギルガルでの即位とイスラエルの人々を述べる文で、「統一王国イスラエル」という場所同定を支えない。
